covered_report_window: After the U.S. market close on Monday, August 24, 2026, through before the U.S. market open on Tuesday, August 25, 2026. No liquid, well-confirmed after-close name passed the shared-universe screen; all ranked names report before Tuesday's open.
market_context_summary: U.S. stocks were mixed near records, with the S&P 500 down about 0.1% and Nasdaq down 0.4% midday; elevated oil, a roughly 4.7% 10-year yield, and anticipation of Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole speech kept inflation and valuation risk elevated.

ranked_companies.timing: Before market open, Aug. 25; 9:00 a.m. ET call
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Preannounced 10.5% comps confirm turnaround momentum, but the stock's run makes guidance quality decisive.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Q2 preliminary sales were $211.6M, up 10.9%, with comps up 10.5%; prior FY26 guidance called for 8%-10% comps and $35M-$40M adjusted EBITDA.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Margin conversion and a higher EBITDA outlook validate the preannounced sales strength.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A merely reiterated guide or fuel/freight margin pressure triggers sell-the-news.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Shares had risen 55.5% since Q1 and short interest was about 11.7% of float; crowding supports both momentum and reversal risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Sparse two-analyst coverage and a preannouncement make published EPS consensus less informative than guidance.

ranked_companies.timing: Before market open, Aug. 25; ~5:30 a.m. ET release
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Improving credit and commercial loan activity support another beat if provisions remain controlled.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Public preview consensus was about C$3.74 EPS and C$9.70B revenue; Q2 adjusted EPS was C$3.67, up 40%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Lower-than-feared provisions and firmer U.S./Canadian commercial loan growth.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Impaired-loan provisions rise or U.S. P&C revenue and margin disappoint.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Shares were down about 1.1% intraday; no reliable event-implied move was found.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The Q2 beat and four-quarter Canadian-bank beat streak lift the real bar despite constructive published estimates.

ranked_companies.timing: Before market open, Aug. 25; 8:15 a.m. ET call
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Canadian margin expansion and lower performing-loan provisions offer modest upside, tempered by international credit risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Public preview consensus was about C$2.08 EPS and C$9.97B revenue; Q2 Canadian Banking profit rose 53% year over year.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Canadian NIM expands and provisions remain below the market's cautious bar.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: International impaired losses rise or capital markets fade from a tough comparison.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Shares were down about 0.9% intraday; no reliable event-implied move was found.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Four consecutive sector-wide beat quarters create a higher whisper bar, limiting conviction.

ranked_companies.timing: Before market open, Aug. 25; 7:30 a.m. ET call
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Soft demand and cautious revenue expectations outweigh resilient profit margins, but compressed valuation limits the edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Public Q2 revenue consensus was about RMB25.14B and EPS about RMB4.06; Q1 profit rose 13.6% while the demand outlook remained cautious.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Customer activity stabilizes, Q3 guidance clears a low bar, and buybacks support the ADS.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Revenue contracts and management signals continued weak discretionary demand.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Shares were down roughly 21% year to date and traded near 6.7x trailing earnings, creating meaningful relief risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Coverage was thin and public timing/estimate pages conflicted, lowering evidence quality.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Foot Locker comps; consolidated margin guide
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Legacy DICK'S comps remain strong, but Foot Locker integration and planned Q2 margin pressure keep the consensus edge modest.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus was about $3.76-$3.78 EPS and $5.65B revenue; Street legacy-DICK'S comp expectations were near 4.1%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Legacy comps exceed 4%, Foot Locker improves, and FY26 guidance rises.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Foot Locker margins and integration costs overwhelm a solid core quarter.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Shares were down about 2.9% intraday and traded near 17.3x trailing earnings; current implied move was unavailable.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Analysts expected at least an in-line quarter and possible guide improvement, so the bar is above headline consensus.
